parameters.name: population_cap
parameters.note: Hard invariant: living population may never exceed this.

parameters.name: years
parameters.note: Simulated duration.

parameters.name: assessment_interval
parameters.note: Civilization-wide assessment cadence, on the civilization anniversary.

parameters.name: adult_civic_age
parameters.note: Age at which a citizen receives an official civic classification.

parameters.name: child_assessment_min_age
parameters.note: Youngest age at which developmental assessment is recorded (not civic).

parameters.name: g_loading
parameters.note: Loading of each cognitive dimension on the general factor g. Order matches cognition.DIMS. Low loadings for practical judgment / social understanding / emotional regulation encode the assumption that these are only weakly predicted by g.

parameters.name: abs_scale_mean
parameters.note: Year-0 absolute capability scale mean.

parameters.name: abs_scale_sd
parameters.note: Year-0 absolute capability scale SD.

parameters.name: test_reliability
parameters.note: Test-retest reliability of the official assessment. Observed = latent + error with SD = abs_scale_sd * sqrt(1 - reliability).

parameters.name: practice_effect
parameters.note: Score inflation per previous official sitting, saturating at practice_max.

parameters.name: practice_max
parameters.note: Ceiling on cumulative practice effect.

parameters.name: state_effect_health
parameters.note: Reduction in observed score at maximal acute ill-health.

parameters.name: state_effect_stress
parameters.note: Reduction in observed score at maximal stress.

parameters.name: sensory_penalty
parameters.note: Observed-score penalty for uncorrected sensory impairment. A measurement artefact, not a capability difference.

parameters.name: iq_report_ceiling
parameters.note: Maximum reportable official score. Latent capability is retained separately.

parameters.name: iq_report_floor
parameters.note: Minimum reportable official score.

parameters.name: normalization_method
parameters.note: Primary normalisation for relative civic IQ. DECLARED BEFORE PRODUCTION RUNS.

parameters.name: fluid_peak_age
parameters.note: Age of peak fluid/speed capability.

parameters.name: fluid_decline_rate
parameters.note: Normal-ageing decline in fluid reasoning and processing speed.

parameters.name: crystallised_growth
parameters.note: Growth in verbal/learned expertise with experience, saturating.

parameters.name: education_effect
parameters.note: Effect of schooling on latent capability during development.

parameters.name: childhood_adversity_effect
parameters.note: Latent capability cost of maximal childhood adversity (nutrition, toxins, stress, illness).

parameters.name: heritability_latent
parameters.note: Share of child's expected latent endowment attributable to a polygenic mid-parent term. NOT a claim about real-world heritability; a model knob whose influence is measured by sensitivity analysis.

parameters.name: shared_environment_share
parameters.note: Share attributable to modelled family/environment inputs.

parameters.name: regression_to_mean
parameters.note: Strength of regression of mid-parent value toward the contemporaneous mean.

parameters.name: gompertz_a
parameters.note: Gompertz baseline hazard at age 0 of the adult component.

parameters.name: gompertz_b
parameters.note: Gompertz rate of hazard increase with age.

parameters.name: makeham_c
parameters.note: Age-independent background mortality.

parameters.name: infant_mortality
parameters.note: First-year death probability before health-system modifiers.

parameters.name: child_mortality
parameters.note: Ages 1-14 baseline death probability.

parameters.name: max_age
parameters.note: Hard age ceiling.

parameters.name: fertility_window
parameters.note: Ages at which a citizen may hold a birth permit.

parameters.name: desired_children_mean
parameters.note: Mean desired completed family size.

parameters.name: desired_children_sd
parameters.note: Dispersion of desired family size.

parameters.name: conception_rate
parameters.note: Annual probability that a permitted, willing, fertile citizen conceives.

parameters.name: fertility_policy
parameters.note: Reproductive-policy module. Held IDENTICAL across A/B/C in the primary comparison; iq_weighted belongs to a separate preregistered phase.

parameters.name: maternal_mortality
parameters.note: Maternal death risk per birth.

parameters.name: chronic_onset_base
parameters.note: Baseline annual chronic-condition onset hazard at age 30.

parameters.name: chronic_age_slope
parameters.note: Exponential increase in chronic onset with age.

parameters.name: dementia_base
parameters.note: Dementia incidence at age 65, doubling every dementia_doubling years.

parameters.name: dementia_doubling
parameters.note: Age doubling time of dementia incidence.

parameters.name: injury_rate_base
parameters.note: Baseline injury hazard before occupational and support modifiers.

parameters.name: mental_health_incidence
parameters.note: Annual onset hazard of a significant mental-health condition.

parameters.name: health_literacy_gradient
parameters.note: Mortality hazard reduction per +1 SD in the health-literacy pathway. This is the ONLY route by which cognition touches mortality directly; accessible systems can close it (see accessibility_closes_gradient).

parameters.name: accessibility_closes_gradient
parameters.note: Fraction of the health-literacy gradient removed at full cognitive accessibility of the health system.

parameters.name: support_mortality_benefit
parameters.note: Proportional hazard reduction when assigned support matches assessed need.

parameters.name: undersupport_mortality_penalty
parameters.note: Proportional hazard increase under severe unmet support need.

parameters.name: oversupport_independence_cost
parameters.note: Loss of adaptive functioning per year of unnecessary supervision. Encodes that more supervision is not automatically better.

parameters.name: medical_innovation_rate
parameters.note: Compounding mortality improvement from accumulated medical knowledge.

parameters.name: healthy_threshold
parameters.note: Health index above which a person-year counts as healthy (HALE).

parameters.name: independence_threshold
parameters.note: Adaptive-functioning index above which a person-year counts as functionally independent.

parameters.name: support_levels
parameters.note: Number of ordered support levels, 0 = independent .. 8 = secure protective care.

parameters.name: support_assessment_error
parameters.note: Noise in the needs assessment; drives over- and under-support.

parameters.name: support_capacity_per_capita
parameters.note: Resource ceiling on total assigned support.

parameters.name: scaffolding_strength
parameters.note: Society-level reduction of unnecessary cognitive burden in civic, medical, financial and transport systems. THE PRIMARY B-vs-A/C treatment lever.

parameters.name: scaffolding_cost
parameters.note: Recurrent cost of accessibility infrastructure.

parameters.name: allocation_rule
parameters.note: Occupational allocation rule.

parameters.name: reallocation_interval
parameters.note: Years between civilization-wide occupational reallocation reviews.

parameters.name: training_rate
parameters.note: Learned-expertise accumulation while employed in a matched role.

parameters.name: experience_performance_weight
parameters.note: Weight of accumulated experience in job performance relative to ability fit.

parameters.name: burnout_rate
parameters.note: Burnout hazard when role demands exceed capability plus support.

parameters.name: mismatch_error_multiplier
parameters.note: Increase in adverse occupational events per unit of role mismatch.

parameters.name: innovation_base
parameters.note: Baseline innovation hazard, scaled by research-role fit and education.

parameters.name: housing_preference_weight
parameters.note: Weight of stated preference against administrative assignment in housing.

parameters.name: housing_capacity_slack
parameters.note: Spare housing stock; scarcity forces suboptimal placement.

parameters.name: iq_bands
parameters.note: Reporting bands for guaranteed representation. Configurable, not hard-coded.

parameters.name: seats_base
parameters.note: Guaranteed seats for every populated band, however small.

parameters.name: seats_proportional
parameters.note: Additional seats allocated proportionally to band population.

parameters.name: leader_competence_iq_link
parameters.note: Correlation between g and *systems-planning* competence. Deliberately modest: the model must not assume high-IQ leadership is good leadership.

parameters.name: leader_ethics_iq_link
parameters.note: Correlation between g and leadership ethics. Default zero (assumption).

parameters.name: corruption_base
parameters.note: Baseline hazard that an official engages in capture or corruption.

parameters.name: audit_effectiveness
parameters.note: Probability that an anti-corruption audit detects an active corruption episode.

parameters.name: policy_effect_strength
parameters.note: Maximum proportional effect of governance quality on health, support and safeguarding budgets.

parameters.name: welfare_check_interval
parameters.note: Maximum interval between mandatory in-person welfare checks.

parameters.name: abuse_attempt_rate
parameters.note: Hazard that a severe-abuse situation is initiated. NOT set to zero.

parameters.name: safeguard_detection_effectiveness
parameters.note: Per-check probability of detecting an active severe-abuse situation.

parameters.name: max_undetected_duration
parameters.note: Hard cap on how long a severe-abuse situation may persist undetected under the default safeguarding regime.

parameters.name: false_positive_rate
parameters.note: Rate of incorrect safeguarding findings; drives administrative cost and harm.

parameters.name: inspector_corruption_rate
parameters.note: Hazard that an inspector is compromised; mitigated by rotation.

parameters.name: intervention_success
parameters.note: Probability that intervention after detection ends the situation within a year.

parameters.name: disaster_rate
parameters.note: Major natural disaster.

parameters.name: epidemic_rate
parameters.note: Epidemic onset.

parameters.name: pandemic_rate
parameters.note: Severe pandemic onset.

parameters.name: crop_failure_rate
parameters.note: Agricultural failure.

parameters.name: infrastructure_failure_rate
parameters.note: Major infrastructure or information-system failure.

parameters.name: economic_contraction_rate
parameters.note: Economic contraction.

parameters.name: breakthrough_rate
parameters.note: Exogenous technological breakthrough.

parameters.name: shock_severity_mean
parameters.note: Mean shock severity.

parameters.name: climate_drift
parameters.note: Slow degradation of environmental carrying capacity.

parameters.name: logging_level
parameters.note: Standard = annual aggregates + 5-year snapshots + all rare events + panel.

parameters.name: panel_size
parameters.note: Reproducible individual-citizen panel retained at full resolution.

parameters.name: checkpoint_interval
parameters.note: Years between full checkpoints.
